entities.name: Ľubica Karvašová
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ľubica Karvašová is a Slovak politician of Progressive Slovakia who was elected member of the European Parliament in 2024. She previously served as European affairs advisor to prime ministers Igor Matovič, Eduard Heger and Ľudovít Ódor.

entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ľubica Karvašová is a Slovak politician of Progressive Slovakia who was elected member of the European Parliament in 2024. She previously served as European affairs advisor to prime ministers Igor Matovič, Eduard Heger and Ľudovít Ódor.
